reason: The knob is LIVE in exp70g. Cell 0 l.57 sets it to 0.25, the builder's --set override comes later in cell 0, and cell 2 l.336 reads it. Cells 3 and 4 do not hard-set it, it is not in the cell-1 drift guard, and safetail, lowrefine and divinsert do not bypass it. The gap-close degrade path fires only after 34,200 s. But the change is too small to use a public slot. The veto sits in close_single_frame_gaps, which runs only on gap-1 pairs whose span is >= 8.5 um (the LAP cap is about 10 um) and whose middle node is synthetic. On the public 4 clips (exp29 run_stats) it checks only 115 pairs: 96 rejected, 19 accepted. UP 0.35 can remove at most 19 pairs (realistically about 5), which is <= 38 edges, or 0.03% of about 121k. DOWN 0.15 might flip about 10-20 of the 96 rejections (the midpoint DeepCenter scores are not logged). That is about 20-40 edges and 10-20 nodes (0.01-0.03%). Part of that change is already absorbed by the fill_gaps_from_low_detections step that runs afterwards, which refills some vetoed gaps with a real sub-threshold peak. So even if every flip is correct, the metric moves by about 1e-4 to 3e-4. That is below the 0.001 display step, so the pair cannot read a sign. The same veto has a sibling knob, DEEPCENTER_GAP_CONFIRM_MIN_SPAN_UM at 9.5 / 7.5 (arms_2 candidate #1), which moves about 35-50 public pairs per arm. That is about 3-5x more, so this idea is dominated. It is also the gap twin of the DeepCenter safe-div threshold, which is closed and lost in both directions at the same 0.25 scale. This threshold is live but inert at display resolution, so it is refuted.
fixed_values: If a DeepCenter gap-veto slot is wanted at all, use the span knob instead: DEEPCENTER_GAP_CONFIRM_MIN_SPAN_UM 9.5 (up) / 7.5 (down). To keep this knob anyway, only large steps change the output visibly: 0.05 (down, which accepts nearly all of the 96 checked public pairs) and 0.50 (up, which drops nearly all of the 19 accepted). Even these stay at or below about 100 edges.
